title: Atlas GA has slipped with no new date, and customers were promised the festive season
why: GA moved from 15 Sep; no replacement date is recorded anywhere; the CEO herself is unsure it will land in time for customers who were promised v3.
suggested_action: Ask Vikram for a committed GA date and a list of customers who were promised the festive season.

title: Backend capacity: two roles paid for but not filled, and hiring is paused
why: Rs 1.77 L advance paid on 30 Jun; no joiner since Feb; hiring paused; the Q2 board update said these hires were to de-risk Atlas.
suggested_action: Decide whether to stop the search (the balance fee) or ring-fence these two roles from the freeze.

title: The leadership's headline numbers do not agree with each other or with the board updates
why: ARR, burn and headcount are quoted very differently by the CEO, CFO and board documents (e.g. Rs 6.1 Cr vs 'forty-two crore'; Rs 44 L vs 'two point two lakhs'). The board wants 'the number' by March.
suggested_action: Agree one definition and one owner for ARR, burn and runway before the board asks.

title: AWS cost up sharply and still climbing
why: Every monthly bill from Apr to Sep is higher than the one before (+37% overall); the August bill, booked in Sep, is the largest and the biggest single step.
suggested_action: Ask for a cost breakdown separating incident-driven spend from structural growth.

title: Only product marketer is leaving right after the summit
why: Siddharth Mehta (Product Marketing Manager) exited 31 Oct and hiring is paused. I am assuming (A-008) that product marketing owns launch messaging for Atlas; launch material arrives later in the week.
suggested_action: Confirm who owns Atlas launch positioning now.

title: Payroll control gap: a new joiner was overpaid in February and the query was never visibly closed
why: Proration was missed when someone covered the payroll run; the employee raised it and got 'will check' with no follow-up on record.
suggested_action: Have Meera confirm the correction and add a proration check to the checklist for covered runs.

title: Routing knowledge may sit with one person (unverified)
why: The CEO says Priya 'basically holds the routing thing together'. Only one second-hand source; engineering data is not in yet.
suggested_action: Wait for commit and Jira data before acting; do not treat as established.
